text:
sara: Heads-up, Nimbus Systems (SI) sent the final artifact bundle for our cloud marketplace listing. Bundle contains: full pen-test report (PDF), vuln-scan export (CSV), SOC2 summary (PDF), and vendor HSM attestation (signed). Marketplace review asked for sanitized artifacts + short attestation. Need owners ASAP.

derek: I can take the sanitization/redaction pass. Plan: clone bundle into a staging workspace, run automated redaction + manual review. Will remove stack dumps, internal hostnames, and any plaintext customer identifiers.

leah: There's a Titan HSM tarball encrypted with the vendor's public key (vendor.tar.gpg). Ops will decrypt after we confirm the approved key procedure. I can handle checksum verification and move certs into the staging bucket: s3://redwood-staging/marketplace/nimbus/.

kyle: Legal note: confirm SI consent for sharing with marketplace reviewers under current NDA. Also, we'll need a one-line attestation for the listing copy. I'll draft two variants (consumer-facing and reviewer-facing).

sara: Owners: @derek = redaction, @leah = HSM decrypt + checksum, @jessica = upload/presign + marketplace contact. Escalate to @lina-sales and @tom-ops if blocked >6h.

jessica: Upload workflow: I'll put sanitized bundle into the marketplace evidence bucket and create presigned URLs for the reviewers. Prefers 7-day presign unless reviewers request longer. Example presign: ```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/nimbus-sanitized-bundle.zip --expires-in 604800``` Will post links here once uploaded.

derek: Redaction checklist (short): remove JSON blobs >1MB, redact email addresses and UUIDs, truncate traces, replace hostnames with [redacted-host]. For CSV scans: collapse fields so only (CVE, severity, status, remediation-summary) are included. No internal pathnames.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: Evidence must be retrievable for 90 days per marketplace audit policy. Also check that presigned URLs use TLS and are logged.

leah: Decrypt process I'll use (GPG vendor key): ```gpg --output vendor.tar.gz --decrypt vendor.tar.gz.gpg``` then `sha256sum vendor.tar.gz > vendor.sha256` then upload vendor.sha256 to staging. Requesting temporary S3 write role from eng-infra.

kyle: Attestation copy suggestion: "Redwood Inference and Nimbus Systems confirm these artifacts are sanitized and free of customer-identifiable information." I'll drop formal text in #legal-drafts for sign-off.

sara: Proposed timeline: Derek finish redaction by Mon 11:00, Leah confirms HSM cert & checksum by Mon 15:00, Jessica uploads & presigns by Mon 18:00, Kyle posts legal attestation by Tue 09:00. If any blocker >6h ping @lina-sales.

jessica: Quick permission Q: marketplace UI can accept reviewer email allowlist for presigned links. Can we get the reviewer emails? If so I'll set ACL to reviewer-only where supported.

derek: Small helper for logs: ```perl -pe "s/\b[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\b/[redacted-uuid]/g" raw_logs/* > sanitized_logs/``` and ```sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,6}/[redacted-email]/g'``` run inside container.

leah: If infra can't grant S3 role quickly, request vendor re-upload through our secure upload form (we'll provide a one-time encrypted form). Prefer to avoid re-uploads but it's a fallback.

kyle: Also confirm if the pen-test company (RedTest Labs) provided a signed attestation. If yes, include the signature file (.sig) in the bundle. If not, ask Nimbus to request it.

sara: Good. Quick sync at 12 to confirm progress? Will leave the huddle invite open for anyone who needs to join. :calendar:

jessica: I'll stand by and post the presigned URLs once the sanitized bundle is pushed. :white_check_mark:
